events.title: Sales Land a Whopper
events.text: Sales landed a huge overseas order. They'd like it booked before anyone checks the FX.

choices.label: Book the lot
choices.quip: Revenue up, risk up. Sales are buying the next round.

choices.label: Phase it over two years
choices.quip: Prudent. Sales have stopped speaking to you.

events.title: The Sales Forecast Arrives
events.text: Sales sent their forecast. It's a hockey stick drawn by someone who's never played hockey.

choices.label: Hedge to the forecast
choices.quip: Bold. The hockey stick has never once been right.

choices.label: Apply a 30% haircut
choices.quip: Sales are wounded. The forecast is now merely optimistic.

events.title: Supplier Wants Paying Early
events.text: Your biggest supplier offers a discount for paying early. Cash today, savings later.

choices.label: Pay early, bank the discount
choices.quip: Discount banked. Runway a touch shorter. The board approves.

choices.label: Keep the cash
choices.quip: The cash stays put. The supplier sends a passive-aggressive email.

events.title: The Auditors Are In
events.text: The auditors want your hedge documentation. All of it. By Friday.

choices.label: Pull an all-nighter
choices.quip: Paperwork immaculate. You, less so. Mind the typos tomorrow.

choices.label: Hire consultants
choices.quip: The consultants bill £40k and ask you where the files are.

events.title: The CEO Has a Hunch
events.text: The CEO read one article and now 'has a feeling' about the dollar. A strong one.

choices.label: Humour him
choices.quip: Risk goes up. The CEO tells everyone it was his idea.

choices.label: Show him the hedging policy
choices.quip: Correct, unpopular and minuted. The CEO sulks until Easter.

events.title: Urgent Email from 'the CEO'
events.text: 'The CEO' emails from a Gmail account. He needs €2m wired to a new supplier. Tonight.

choices.label: Ring the real CEO
choices.quip: Fake, obviously. The CEO is touched you checked. Briefly.

choices.label: Buy proper payment controls
choices.quip: Dual sign-off on everything now. Even the biscuit order.

events.title: Setting the Budget Rate
events.text: The board wants a budget rate for next year. Every director has a different number.

choices.label: Use the forward rate
choices.quip: Defensible and dull. Half the board nods off.

choices.label: Average everyone's guess
choices.quip: Democracy in action. Nobody's right, but everyone feels heard.

events.title: Procurement Found a Bargain
events.text: Procurement wants to buy a year of raw materials at once. 'It's a bargain,' they say.

choices.label: Stockpile it
choices.quip: The car park is now a warehouse. Price risk: parked.

choices.label: Buy as normal
choices.quip: Procurement mutters about 'treasury killing deals'. Again.

events.title: A Bank Bearing Gifts
events.text: A new relationship manager offers a clever structured product. And Wimbledon tickets.

choices.label: Sign up, enjoy Wimbledon
choices.quip: Lovely strawberries. Then the board read the 14 pages of footnotes.

choices.label: Ask for a plain forward
choices.quip: The banker looks crestfallen. The board looks quietly relieved.

events.title: Banks Offer to Refinance
events.text: The banks will refinance your floating-rate debt if you sign today. For a fee, naturally.

choices.label: Sign and fix most of it
choices.quip: Fee paid, rates tamed. The bankers celebrate with your money.

choices.label: Stay floating
choices.quip: No fee. No sleep either, whenever the ECB clears its throat.

events.title: The Cheque Is in the Post
events.text: Your largest customer says payment is 'in the post'. The post, apparently, takes 90 days.

choices.label: Chase them hard
choices.quip: Cash in. The customer is now 'reviewing suppliers'. Gulp.

choices.label: Let it slide
choices.quip: Relationship preserved. Cash flow, less so.

events.title: The Intern Built a Model
events.text: The intern built a forecasting model: 47 tabs and one macro, called 'PRAY'.

choices.label: Use the intern's model
choices.quip: Annoyingly, it works. The board asks why you need a team.

choices.label: Stick with the old model
choices.quip: Tradition wins. The intern quietly applies to a hedge fund.

events.title: Port Strike
events.text: The dockers are on strike. Your imports are bobbing about offshore with nowhere to go.

choices.label: Air-freight the urgent bits
choices.quip: Costly, but the shelves are full. Your courier sends a hamper.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.quip: Volumes vanish. Your hedges are now bigger than your business.

events.title: The Keynote Overran
events.text: The keynote ran 40 minutes over. Your hedge committee is now a corridor chat.

choices.label: Decide it in the corridor
choices.quip: Decisive. Also undocumented. The auditors will love this.

choices.label: Reschedule it properly
choices.quip: Minuted and correct. The board asks why it took a fortnight.

events.title: Lanyard Mix-up
events.text: You've worn a rival CFO's lanyard all morning. Banks keep pitching you their prices.

choices.label: Lean into it
choices.quip: You now know their bank pricing. Ethically grey, very useful.

choices.label: Swap back, sheepishly
choices.quip: Honour intact. The rival CFO kept your free pen.

events.title: The Coffee Queue
events.text: The coffee queue is 30 deep. The bank's FX desk is ringing about rolling your hedges.

choices.label: Take the call, skip coffee
choices.quip: Hedges rolled, nerves frayed. You now speak in basis points.

choices.label: Hold out for the flat white
choices.quip: Superb flat white. It cost you one missed fixing.

events.title: The CFO Is at the Bar
events.text: Your CFO is at the bar, telling a banker your hedge ratios. Loudly.

choices.label: Join in and steer
choices.quip: You stay on message and buy the round. All of it. Expensed.

choices.label: Leave them to it
choices.quip: Next morning, the bank's forward quotes are mysteriously wider.

events.title: Phone at 3%
events.text: Your phone is on 3%. The team needs a yes or no on this quarter's hedges. Now.

choices.label: Text 'yes' and pray
choices.quip: Sent at 1%. Autocorrect changed 'roll' to 'troll'.

choices.label: Find a charger first
choices.quip: A stranger lends you a charger. And a pitch for their fintech.

events.title: Swag Overload
events.text: You've collected 14 tote bags and 9 stress balls. The board wants 'conference ROI'.

choices.label: Present the stress balls
choices.quip: The board squeezes them throughout your hedge report. Telling.

choices.label: Write a proper trip report
choices.quip: Three pages, two insights, one lanyard. The board is impressed.
